title: Policy Central: Detecting Conflicts, Redundancy, and Similarity in Deployed Police Policy
abstract: arXiv:2610.29338v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Policy Central is a deployed system that helps police departments find relationships between sections of their written policy: whether two sections conflict, are redundant, are merely similar, or are different. We describe the system and compare two architectures. Retrieve-Judge, a retrieve-then-classify pipeline, runs as a cheap library-wide health signal; Screen-Confirm, a screen-then-confirm cascade, is a selective audit of the documents a reviewer chooses, checking them exhaustively against one another. On a 302-pair benchmark drawn from one department's ~84 real policy documents, given each pair Screen-Confirm reaches 0.795 aggregate recall and 0.885 on Conflict, so current models judge well. Finding the pair is the hard part: Retrieve-Judge's composed recall falls to 0.457, and Screen-Confirm recovers 0.472 (0.615 on Conflict). Today these pairs are found by reading the whole library, nearly 20,000 sections, checked against one ano

translated_title: Policy Central：检测已部署警务政策中的冲突、冗余与相似性
translated_abstract: Policy Central 是一个已部署的系统，帮助警察部门发现其书面政策各条款之间的关系：判断两个条款是相互冲突、冗余、仅相似还是不同。论文介绍了该系统并比较了两种架构：Retrieve-Judge 是一种“先检索后分类”的流水线，作为覆盖整个政策库的低成本健康信号运行；Screen-Confirm 是一种“先筛选后确认”的级联架构，对审阅者选定的文档进行选择性审计，并将其与其他文档进行详尽比对。在基于某警察部门约 84 份真实政策文档构建的 302 对基准测试中，对于给定的每一对文档，Screen-Confirm 达到 0.795 的总体召回率，在冲突类上达到 0.885，说明当前模型在判断环节表现良好。难点在于找到这些配对：Retrieve-Judge 的端到端召回率降至 0.457，Screen-Confirm 可恢复至 0.472（冲突类为 0.615）。目前这些配对是通过人工阅读整个政策库（近 20,000 个条款）并相互比对得出的。
tldr: 论文部署了名为 Policy Central 的系统，通过比较“先检索后分类”与“先筛选后确认”两种架构来检测警察政策条款间的冲突、冗余与相似性，发现模型判断环节表现良好（冲突类召回率达 0.885），但在近两万条款中找到相关配对仍是主要瓶颈，端到端召回率仅约 0.46。
en_tdlr: Policy Central is a deployed system comparing a Retrieve-Judge pipeline with a Screen-Confirm cascade to detect conflicts, redundancy, and similarity across police policy sections, showing that while current models judge pairs well (0.885 recall on Conflict), finding relevant pairs across nearly 20,000 sections remains the hard part, with end-to-end recall of only about 0.46.
